blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lirick Mendoza took matters into his own hands to lead Far Eastern University-DN Steel into the semifinals after ousting Alpha Insurance, 33-31, 25-18, 19-25, 25-20, in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Wednesday at FilOil EcoOil Centre in San Juan City. Mendoza nailed seven blocks to finish with a game-high 18 points as the Tamaraws completed the semifinals cast of the pioneering men’s volleyball club league, joining unbeaten defending champion Criss Cross, last conference’s runner-up Savouge, and National University-Archipelago Builders, who benefited from their win. “We really needed to win to secure our place in the semifinals.
